items.title: s2: Maren's use of her approved Skill (Thorn Lash pinned the thrall at the wagon) not extracted as her event; 'maren thorn lash ... wick finished it off' became only Wick's kill
notes: Fixed (pipeline.js NEW_OCCASION regex). Root cause confirmed via real-model probe + report.json: stage-1 correctly emitted Thorn Lash as its own event, but flagged continuesPrevious:true; the fold regex did not treat 'then' as a new-occasion marker, so mergeFollowUpEvents silently joined it into Entangle (report.json's merged quote 'maren entangle only got 1 of 4 ... then Thorn Lash...' matches the merge code's join pattern exactly). Fix: 'then' now blocks the fold regardless of the model's flag, plus a reinforcing few-shot (Rin/Web/Ensnaring Strike/Dorn). New unit tests reproduce the exact pre-fix shape and assert both events survive. Real model: baseline probe never reproduced the merge in 13 reps of the actual s2 notes (low-probability flake); post-fix, Thorn Lash+kill stayed separate in all 9 reps too -- the guard is now structural, not just probabilistic. npm test 774/774 green.
PM verified s3 on main: 'Maren used Thorn Lash on the third guard', 'Maren healed the guard with Field Triage', Luz Public Edict, Brakka Bottleneck, Wick Oxwhip - all approved-Skill uses credited.

items.title: s2: two spells in one line merged into one event with one outcome: 'luz sanctuary on Oren (shrugged off), sacred flame, guiding bolt missed' -> 'Luz cast Sacred Flame and Guiding Bolt' failure (Sacred Flame hit)
notes: Mitigated (prompts.js few-shot), not a pipeline-merge bug: confirmed the real session's merged event ('Luz cast Sacred Flame and Guiding Bolt') was emitted by stage-1 as ONE JSON event, not folded by mergeFollowUpEvents (whose join never rewrites .summary, which the real event's summary structure ruled out). Fix: new few-shot teaching that several named abilities in a comma list with a result word on only the last one are still N separate events (Kade/Mage Armor/Fireball). Real model: separate in all 13 baseline reps AND all 9 post-fix reps of the actual s2 notes -- did not reproduce the merge either way in this sampling (it's a rarer model flake than 40d30e3d), so this is evidence-based prevention, not a reproduced-then-verified fix. Regression sanity: 112-item run (novel-activities/long-multiscene/bullets-fragments/traps) score 96.4%, count 90.2%, fallback 0%, traps 100% -- no regression. npm test 774/774 green.

items.title: s2: Maren's baking with Oren (amazing bread, drew out his testimony) not extracted; cottagecore downtime is the persona's growth
notes: Fixed (prompts.js few-shot), the most reproducible of the three: 'bread w/ Oren was amazing' was never emitted by stage-1 at all in 5 of 13 baseline real-model reps of the actual s2 notes (~38% miss rate), confirmed by grepping the raw stage-1 JSON for 'bread' before any coercion ran -- an elliptical, implied-verb evaluative clause ('X with Y was amazing/lovely', actor carried from the previous sentence) reads as scenery, not a doer's action. Fix: new few-shot (Nessa/tomatoes-rotted/Stew with Bael) teaching the pattern is still that character's event, themed craft/cooking. Real model: present in 9/9 post-fix reps of the actual notes.md vs 8/13 baseline (~62%) -- clear improvement, though stage-1 extraction is stochastic at temp 0.2-0.3 so this is not a 100% guarantee. Regression sanity: 112-item run score 96.4%, count 90.2%, fallback 0%. npm test 774/774 green.
